title: Steelers left tackle Broderick Jones needs further evaluation after neck injury setback

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers left tackle Broderick Jones needs further evaluation after neck injury setback
sources.description: When Steelers left tackle Broderick Jones injured his neck in Week 12, it was not believed to be overly serious, and there was talk that he could return for the playoffs.
